• The word **"Deliverence"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Deliverance" which means the action of being rescued or set free. (मुक्ति)

 
 
• **Example: **They prayed for deliverance from their suffering.

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Banquet **(भोज): A large formal meal for many people.

 
 
• **Example:** The royal banquet was held in honor of the visiting dignitaries.
 
 
 
• **Condescend **(अनुग्रह करना): Show feelings of superiority; be patronizing.
 
 
• **Example: **He would not condescend to answer the questions of the commoners.
 
 
 
• **Alliteration** (अनुप्रास): The occurrence of the same letter or sound at the beginning of adjacent or closely connected words.
 
 
• **Example:** "She sells sea shells by the sea shore" is an example of alliteration.
